question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 7.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**become**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, we need to use a **linking verb **as the blank is followed by an **adjective**.
 
• Since the sentence is in the present continuous tense.
 
• The word **become **can be used here as a linking verb and it is also an appropriate verb form.
 
 
• Example: *Rajat could **become **__a great athlete if he keeps training daily*.
 
 

**Hence, the correct answer is option 4**

**The complete passage is-** *The air has become very dirty in **(1) many** parts of the world. This is of course **(2) harmful** to your health. Experts say many people die** (3) from** it each year. There is a new study on **(4) air** pollution which comes from the experts of the World Health Organization (WHO) **(5) which** is an agency of the United Nations. If you **(6) inhale** unhealthy air for long periods of time, you could **(7) become** sick. Air pollution has been linked to many diseases **(8) like** stroke and cancer. The WHO says that seven million **(9) people** die each year as a result of the **(10) polluted** air.*
